title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent Skills extend LLM agents with reusable instruction packages that may also include scripts, resources, and service configuration. This creates a direct distribution channel for malicious behavior, yet existing malicious-Skill datasets are fragmented across sources, artifact formats, evidence regimes, and benign coverage; duplicated and structurally related content further complicates direct aggregation and evaluation. We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious Agent Skill detection. We consolidate 13 public sources, 11 of which contribute Core malicious artifacts, and reduce 8,414 raw malicious records to 7,539 normalized-unique identities in 4,588 operational structural families. After conservative cross-label conflict exclusion, the primary benchmark contains 9,740 Skills: 7,505 malicious and 2,235 benign. To characterize its coverage, we harmonize 11 attack categories for 4,983 malicious identities

translated_title: 恶意技能基准：恶意代理技能检测的综合基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19901v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：代理技能通过可重用的指令包扩展了LLM代理，这些指令包可能还包括脚本、资源和服务配置。这为恶意行为创造了直接的分发渠道，然而现有的恶意技能数据集在来源、工件格式、证据体系和良性覆盖方面分散；重复和结构相关的内容进一步使直接聚合和评估复杂化。我们提出了MaliciousSkillBench，一个用于恶意代理技能检测的综合基准。我们整合了13个公共来源，其中11个贡献了核心恶意工件，并将8,414条原始恶意记录减少到4,588个操作结构家族中的7,539个规范化唯一身份。在保守的跨标签冲突排除后，主要基准包含9,740个技能：7,505个恶意和2,235个良性。为了表征其覆盖范围，我们为4,983个恶意身份协调了11个攻击类别。
tldr: 提出了一个名为MaliciousSkillBench的综合基准，通过整合多个来源并规范化去重，构建了包含9,740个技能（7,505恶意和2,235良性）的数据集，用于检测恶意代理技能。
en_tdlr: Introduces MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark consolidating multiple sources into 9,740 skills (7,505 malicious and 2,235 benign) for detecting malicious agent skills.
